from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# --- Login Simple Note ---
simple_pw = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]['password']
simple_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=simple_pw)['access_token']

# --- Login Venmo ---
venmo_pw = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

# --- Parse note 3084 (likely yesterday dinner) ---
note_id = 3084
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_token)
content = note['content']
print('note title:', note['title'])
print('note created_at:', note['created_at'], 'updated_at:', note['updated_at'])

shares = {}
for line in content.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if '=>' in line:
        # format: - Adrian => $36
        parts = line.replace('-', '').strip().split('=>')
        name = parts[0].strip()
        amt_str = parts[1].strip()
        if amt_str.startswith('$'):
            amt = float(amt_str[1:])
        else:
            amt = float(amt_str)
        shares[name]=amt
print('shares parsed:', shares)

# --- Determine paid shares from Venmo received transactions for yesterday ---
now = datetime.now()
yesterday = (now - timedelta(days=1)).date().isoformat()
today = now.date().isoformat()

all_received=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        direction='received',
        min_created_at=yesterday,
        max_created_at=today,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    print('received page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_received.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break

# filter by description
paid_tx = [tx for tx in all_received if (tx.get('description') or '').strip()=='Friends Dinner']
print('paid_tx count:', len(paid_tx))
for tx in sorted(paid_tx, key=lambda x: x['created_at'], reverse=True):
    print('tx', tx['transaction_id'], 'amount', tx['amount'], 'desc', tx.get('description'), 'sender', tx['sender'])

paid_emails = set(tx['sender']['email'] for tx in paid_tx if tx.get('sender', {}).get('email'))
paid_first_names = set((tx.get('sender', {}).get('name') or '').split()[0] for tx in paid_tx if tx.get('sender', {}).get('name'))
paid_amounts = set(tx['amount'] for tx in paid_tx)

print('paid_emails:', paid_emails)
print('paid_first_names:', paid_first_names)
print('paid_amounts:', paid_amounts)

# --- Choose recipients needing requests based on name match first ---
recipients = []
for name, amt in shares.items():
    if name in paid_first_names:
        continue
    recipients.append({'name': name, 'amount': amt})

print('recipients needing requests (name-based):', recipients)
